_doc: Labor status, managed by code (Character_Trainable.StartIntenseLabor / EndIntenseLaborState). chara_status_labor_intense: shown while a baby is in intense labor (bed rest comes from labor itself, UtilityEX.IsInLabor). Flat severity 100, no decay.

list._comment: Early labor progress, set by code (ReproductionUtility.UpdateLaborStatus) whenever labor progresses: severity = % of early labor elapsed (0-100), duration = minutes left (-1 once early labor has run its length and she waits to rest). Removed when active labor starts (chara_status_labor_intense labels that stage) or labor ends. Display only.
list._comment_variants: two variants only to give severity its 0-100 range (Status_Instance.SeveritySet clamps between the first and last variant thresholds); both show the same label

list._comment: Shown for the whole labor when a baby cannot be delivered naturally (ReproductionUtility.CanDeliverSafely failed) - the labor ends in a C-section. Display only; managed by code (ReproductionUtility.SetLaborObstructed).

zh-cn.chara_status_labor_tooltip:
临产会随时间推进
临产结束后，只有在清醒并卧床静养（或其他休息指令）时才会进入分娩
zh-cn.chara_status_labor_intense_tooltip: 只有在清醒并卧床静养（或其他休息指令）时，分娩才会推进
zh-cn.chara_status_labor_obstructed_active_too:
无法自然生产，需要进医院才可完成生产
若当前世界中没有该角色可以抵达的医院，则会强制自然生产

en-us.chara_status_labor_tooltip:
Early labor advances over time.
Once it has run its course, active labor only begins while awake and resting (Bed Rest or another rest command).
en-us.chara_status_labor_intense_tooltip: Labor only progresses toward birth while awake and resting (Bed Rest or another rest command).
